coverage: Reported business segments · sales and other income
definition: Reported segment earnings before the remaining finance-cost deduction and income tax; financing-business costs already reflected in its segment result are not added back.
location: Notes to consolidated financial statements, Note 44(a), Business segment, year ended 31 March 2026 table
notes: Segment revenue includes other income: ₹65,087.22 crore reconciles to total income, not operating revenue of ₹62,905 crore. No intersegment sales are reported. Segment results of ₹14,211.75 crore less remaining finance costs of ₹260.21 crore give PBT of ₹13,951.54 crore; tax and non-controlling interests follow.
insight: Automotive contributes the largest revenue and segment earnings here. Investments and lending earn differently from selling vehicles; segment result is not group PAT or profit per motorcycle.
incomeDefinition: Reported segment income combines vehicle sales, financing income and investment or other income. It is broader than revenue from operations and is not entirely product sales.
